text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen someone completely 
intoxicated, with glazed-over, dead eyes? 
—I have. That was the Trainer's eyes back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That evil eye, drunk on sheer frenzy, saw 
right through me. It noticed a bad habit 
that even I wasn't aware of— veering 
outward when pushed hard down the 
homestretch.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I fixed things and cut out the bad root 
before the Shinzan Kinen. Rejoice, Goddess 
of Victory. The supreme me is coming for 
you.
